title: The internal commutative-group identification commutes with abelian etale direct image
statement: Let U,V be schemes [def-pc-scheme], f:U\to V, S_T the category of sheaves of sets on the small etale site of T [def-weil-pbc-etale-site, def-weil-pbc-etale-sheaf-of-sets], A_T the category of abelian sheaves [def-weil-pbc-abelian-etale-sheaves], and FaT:A_T\to S_T the sectionwise forgetful functor. Let R:S_U\to S_V and Ra:A_U\to A_V be the set and abelian direct images by precomposition with etale base change [def-weil-pbc-direct-image]. Endow R with the canonical braided monoidal structure induced by its preservation of finite products, and let R^gr be its lift to internal commutative group objects [lem-weil-pbc-adjunction-lifts-abelian-group-objects]. There exist equivalences eV:A_V\simeq CommGrp(S_V), eU:A_U\simeq CommGrp(S_U), natural isomorphisms iV:eV\,forget\simeq FaV and iU:eU\,forget\simeq FaU, and a natural isomorphism beta:eU\,R^gr\simeq Ra\,eV such that for every F in A_U, forget(beta_F) followed by iV_(Ra F) equals R(iU_F). No inverse-image functor or finite-limit hypothesis on it occurs.

source.place: Section 00YR, quadruple description; Proposition 00YV, proof of (2), the pushforward paragraph

proof.text: Apply the sectionwise abelian identification at each small etale site. Its strict inverse functors define equivalences eV and eU, and its underlying-functor identities give iV and iU. The equivalence constructor may adjust unit/counit data but leaves the functors and these comparisons unchanged.

The continuous base-change functor gives the set direct image R and abelian direct image Ra by precomposition, using Etale.isContinuous_overPullback and Etale.lowerStar. Products and terminal sheaves are sectionwise. CartesianMonoidalCategory.hom_ext and Functor.Monoidal.μ_fst/μ_snd prove that the canonical multiplication comparison of R is the identity. Evaluation of the unit and multiplication maps therefore gives the original zero and addition at the base-changed object.

For an abelian sheaf A on U, define c_A as R.mapIso(iU_A) followed by the inverse of iV_(Ra A). Cancel iV_(Ra A) in the unit and multiplication equations. The section formulas of the abelian identification at U and V show that c_A preserves zero and addition, giving IsMonHom(c_A.hom). Mathlib CommGrp.mkIso' lifts this underlying isomorphism to a commutative-group-object isomorphism; it derives compatibility of the inverse and group inverses from the forward monoid-homomorphism equations.

Naturality of iU and iV and the precomposition formulas for Ra show that these isomorphisms are natural in F; faithfulness of the internal-group forgetful functor gives naturality upstairs. This constructs beta. Composing its underlying map with iV_(Ra F) cancels iV inverse and gives R(iU_F), which is the displayed compatibility equation.

lean.statement:
theorem etaleAbelianDirectImageInternal (U V : Scheme.{u}) (f : U ⟶ V) :
    let R : Sheaf U.smallEtaleTopology (Type (u + 1)) ⥤
        Sheaf V.smallEtaleTopology (Type (u + 1)) :=
      (MorphismProperty.Over.pullback @Etale ⊤ f).sheafPushforwardContinuous
      (Type (u + 1)) (V.smallGrothendieckTopology @Etale)
      (U.smallGrothendieckTopology @Etale)
    letI : R.Braided := Functor.Braided.ofChosenFiniteProducts R
    ∃ (eV : Sheaf V.smallEtaleTopology AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1} ≌
          CommGrp (Sheaf V.smallEtaleTopology (Type (u + 1))))
      (eU : Sheaf U.smallEtaleTopology AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1} ≌
          CommGrp (Sheaf U.smallEtaleTopology (Type (u + 1))))
      (iV : eV.functor ⋙ CommGrp.forget _ ≅
        sheafForget (D := AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1}) V.smallEtaleTopology)
      (iU : eU.functor ⋙ CommGrp.forget _ ≅
        sheafForget (D := AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1}) U.smallEtaleTopology)
      (β : eU.functor ⋙ R.mapCommGrp ≅
        Etale.lowerStar AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1} f ⋙ eV.functor),
      ∀ F : Sheaf U.smallEtaleTopology AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1},
        (CommGrp.forget _).map (β.hom.app F) ≫
            iV.hom.app ((Etale.lowerStar AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1} f).obj F) =
          R.map (iU.hom.app F)
